newsitem.title: CHINA: China newspaper urges confidence after crackdown.
newsitem.headline: China newspaper urges confidence after crackdown.

text.p: China's top official securities newspaper on Wednesday urged investors to maintain their confidence in the development of the stock markets following Beijing's share trading crackdown this week.
"We must wipe out any doubts and be fully confident of the stable development of the markets on the basis of standardisation," the China Securities newspaper said.
The newspaper said the current crackdown on the markets was aimed at standardising market activity and told local securities authorities to take the lead in publicising the official view.
It also urged exchanges, securities houses, listed firms and the mass media to participate in the campaign against excessive speculation and irregularities on the share markets.
A harshly worded commentary in the People's Daily on Monday said that China's stock markets were overheated and warned that if there was a crash, Beijing would not step in to help investors.
